scope: Ordinary black-border Legends, shared across all eight frame materials. Original and Oracle typography use the same printing profile. Other sets and explicit templates remain unchanged.
method: Shared type parameters fit only on training cards. Real painter replay, unchanged scan poses and no changes outside the type strip. Scores are type-only two-polarity edge F1, not full-card accuracy.
cohort: UUID order before measurements; alternating training/validation. Frozen scan-only poses. Canvas type layers checked against real full render. Gold and other printed materials evaluated separately.
remaining: Mana, rules, artist and power/toughness remain separate calibration passes.
Lettering texture and ink/shadow shape are not fitted by this size and position study.

normalizationReview.note: Original measurements preserved. Corrected frame, color, title/type/symbol rechecks and fresh text validation are reported separately, including retained regressions.
